summary: The prepared main snapshot already contains the release-to-main correction. Commit 60ff1e33a51f363b8426d85e3434a1eb48e1b70a ([DeepSeek V4] Default FP4 checkpoints to FlashInfer MXFP4 MoE) is absent from v0.5.18 commit 71de97b264b04dcd514cf904003028aefe9775c8, is an ancestor of the reporter's working a1fe4e30a983b04bbb74099dfc71bc7148c5c577 snapshot, and makes detected DeepSeek-V4 FP4 experts select flashinfer_mxfp4 on SM90/SM100/SM120. No production-code change was needed. The existing regression was made host-independent and expanded to cover the reported SM90 boundary plus SM100 and SM120.

tests.what_was_measured: The regression leaked the physical ROCm platform into its nominal SM100 fixture, so the expected flashinfer_mxfp4 selection was absent. Raw output: /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-1ebd62d7dbd9/evidence/model_override_test.txt

Three positive subtests verify auto-selection of flashinfer_mxfp4 for detected FP4 experts on SM90, SM100, and SM120. Existing independent boundaries verify explicit runner selection, A2A, dequant override, FP8 experts, HIP/NPU, unsupported NVIDIA architectures, and NVFP4 behavior. Raw output: /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-1ebd62d7dbd9/evidence/model_override_test_after.txt

The SM90 FlashInfer execution test was collected but skipped at module scope because the assigned device is AMD gfx950, not NVIDIA SM90; pytest reports no runnable tests. Raw output: /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-1ebd62d7dbd9/evidence/sm90_cutlass_test.txt

tests.command: /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-1ebd62d7dbd9/venv/bin/python (8x8 float32 GPU matmul compared with CPU torch reference)
tests.what_was_measured: Execution on the assigned AMD Instinct MI350X gfx950 GPU produced max_abs_error 0.0. This confirms GPU availability only, not the NVIDIA SM90 issue path. Raw output: /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-1ebd62d7dbd9/evidence/gfx950_gpu_check.txt

tests.command: git comparison of v0.5.18 (71de97b), fix commit 60ff1e33, working snapshot a1fe4e30, and prepared base
tests.what_was_measured: The fix commit is absent from the release, is an ancestor of the reported working snapshot, and equivalent selection logic exists in the prepared base. Raw output: /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-1ebd62d7dbd9/evidence/history.txt

gpu_execution_evidence: A numerical torch matmul ran on the single assigned AMD Instinct MI350X (gfx950) and matched the CPU reference exactly. The relevant FlashInfer SM90 kernel could not run on this architecture.
remaining_limitations: The reported DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 weights and four H800/SM90 GPUs were unavailable. Therefore no full-model, TP=4, DSPARK, HTTP-serving, semantic-accuracy, or actual FlashInfer SM90 kernel reproduction is claimed. The deterministic result covers the configuration/routing defect and boundaries only. The source issue remains open upstream, so this is classified candidate_verified rather than fixed.
